stories.headline: More troops to be sent to West Bank village besieged by Israeli settlers
stories.description: Two Palestinian families in Qusra are trapped in their homes without water or power.

stories.headline: Yemeni forces say Houthi attack repelled in Taiz amid escalation
stories.description: Military escalation continues for days after the Yemeni government announced it is attacking Houthi positions.

stories.headline: Settler siege of Palestinian homes in West Bank a 'horrific act of terror,' US ambassador says
stories.description: The US ambassador to Israel condemned settlers besieging an American Palestinian family's home.

stories.headline: As temperatures soar, ‘exceptionally serious’ drought imperils UK farmers
stories.description: Farmers trying to adapt to extreme weather say even with the best planning, their industry is facing its toughest test.

stories.headline: Three US states to hold executions on same day for first time since 2010
stories.description: The last three executions on the same day happened 16 years ago, in Louisiana, Ohio and Texas.
